_comment: Companies that are not the actual employer, or mass reposters whose volume says nothing about hiring demand. Reviewed by hand from the top-volume companies (2026-04-06 to 2026-10-07). Matched by exact company name. Synced into the aggregator_companies table on every SQLiteStorage init. Real IT-services employers that repost a lot (BairesDev, EPAM, CI&T...) are not listed: deduplicating by (title, company) already absorbs their reposts.

categories.job_board: Job boards / feeds re-posting other companies' ads (company field is not the employer)
categories.talent_marketplace: AI-training / freelance talent marketplaces (gig work, not developer jobs per se)
categories.mass_reposter: Mass multi-country reposters (same title posted in ~100 locations)

companies.reason: job feed: 10k IDs for ~240 titles (43 IDs/title), almost no <25 applicants
aggregator marketplace (LinkedIn industry: Internet Marketplace Platforms)
spam poster (job IDs embedded in titles)
AI-training gig marketplace; 18 IDs/title in 68 locations
